description: This file contains a Go program that processes Markdown content, parses embedded HTML blocks, and performs translation of HTML text segments while respecting the structure of the HTML. It uses the Goldmark Markdown parser and the golang.org/x/net/html package to tokenize and manipulate HTML within Markdown documents.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Parses Markdown body content, identifies embedded HTML blocks, and replaces their translated counterparts within the document.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the span (start and end positions) of an HTML block within the source byte array.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies sorted HTML replacements to the original body string to produce a translated version.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the list of HTML replacements based on their start positions.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Tokenizes an HTML segment and translates text nodes unless within skip tags (like <code> or <pre>).

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines if a text segment should be translated based on skip depth and emptiness.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag is among those that should be skipped for translation.
